title: Deriving and Evaluating a Detailed Taxonomy of Game Bugs
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a taxonomy of game bugs through a Multivocal Literature Review and a systematic review of white and grey literature. While 'ethics' is mentioned in the 'Threats to Validity' section, it refers to general research ethics (resolving conflicts among authors) and not to the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of the paper's subject matter. The paper's primary focus is game bugs and testing approaches.
